commands.name: CreateSpareRequestDraft
steps: validate all Needs belong same SR; resolve requester Contact as active and capture bounded REQUESTER_CONTEXT_V1 from the exact Contact/current affiliation effective at creation; independently snapshot receiver/location eligibility
inside UoW revalidate SR/Needs/requester active/current Contact revision/current affiliation token plus draft receiver/location eligibility
allocate spare_request_id and non-reusable SPR-########
insert receipt/request with requester_contact_id + immutable requester_context_json, draft allocations and draft logistics
audit and commit
rules: requester is an explicit reusable Contact role and is never inferred from receiver, SR Customer or handler
requester and receiver may be the same Contact or different active Contacts
requester relationship/context are fixed as creation evidence and survive later Contact affiliation/descriptive changes and terminal request history
current SR customer ticket owner may be suggested by UI as requester candidate but command never silently chooses it

commands.name: UpdateSpareRequestDraft
steps: inside UoW require current request state=draft and no accepted real submission
revalidate all Needs same SR and positive quantities plus active selectable receiver/location
insert receipt; close/replace draft allocations and current draft logistics atomically
audit diff and commit
rules: requester_contact_id/requester_context_json are creation evidence and are not editable through draft logistics update
submitted snapshot, when present as preserved corrected history, is never edited

commands.name: AcceptSpareRequestSubmission
steps: inside UoW require nonempty positive current allocations, valid receiver/location/mode and no current accepted real submission
insert receipt/submission_accepted event
freeze immutable submission snapshot and exact allocation/BOM rows
set response warning start from accepted effective submission time when known else recording time only as submission chronology explicitly confirmed by operator; never from MSG generation
rebuild request projection/audit/commit
rules: MSG generation/export/open does not call this command
submission recipient context never replaces requester creation evidence

commands.name: CorrectFalseSpareRequestSubmission
steps: inside UoW prove target event is current submission authority and no accepted downstream SR7/RMA/dispatch/receipt evidence makes false-send claim contradictory
insert receipt/submission_corrected_false targeting original
retain immutable old snapshot as corrected history but restore current draft semantics and stop response warning
rebuild projection/audit/commit
commands.rule: correction preserves original event/source/chronology and never rewrites requester creation evidence

commands.name: AssignOrCorrectSpareRequestOfficialId
steps: validate SR+7 digits and global non-reuse against current/former aliases
inside UoW revalidate request and expected current identifier
insert receipt/identifier event; demote prior current alias to former when correcting; insert new current alias
append acknowledgement lifecycle evidence when first official response is accepted as applicable
rebuild request projection/audit/commit
rules: genuinely different request requires new entity

commands.name: AcceptRmaAuthorizationBatch
input: ordered one-or-more C10 + promised BOM rows
steps: outside lock validate unique canonical C10 values/order/BOM keys and preview target assignments
inside UoW require current SR7, accepted submission/external registration authority and no C10 conflicts
allocate next authorization batch ordinal
insert receipt/batch; create one RMA per row preserving response ordinal and C10 current alias
run RMA_ASSIGNMENT_V1 in preserved batch/response order against compatible unassigned Device Part Units by creation_sequence
append assignment events/current rows when deterministic; unresolved/incompatible remain unassigned with attention
append authorization_progress lifecycle event, rebuild request/RMA attention projections, audit/commit
rules: partial number of RMAs is valid
no provisional physical unit is created before receipt
later batches continue over remaining unassigned targets

commands.name: CorrectRmaOfficialId
steps: inside UoW revalidate current alias and global non-reuse
insert receipt/correction event; retain old alias former and new alias current
rebuild trackable identity projection/audit/commit
commands.rule: submitted Fault Tag snapshots remain unchanged historical display evidence

commands.name: SetRmaTargetAssignment
input: new target Device Part Unit or clear
steps: inside UoW validate target belongs same SR through request and BOM compatibility; target cannot be assigned to another current RMA
insert receipt/assignment event
replace/clear current assignment without editing prior events
rebuild RMA attention/audit/commit
rules: does not prove receipt, installation or return unit

commands.name: CancelOrRejectSpareRequest
steps: inside UoW reject transition if accepted downstream obligations make requested terminal meaning invalid
insert receipt/lifecycle event
rebuild request/Need dependency projections and audit/commit
commands.rule: terminal request history, including immutable requester Contact/context, remains and only then may associated Need history-removal eligibility be reconsidered
